## Research leadership and collaborations

As a PhD student I established the ongoing BrainDrugs-Depression cohort, secured ethical approval and assembled a team of more than twenty medical and engineering students who assist with data acquisition. I have served as primary study physician on a clinical drug trial in obsessive-compulsive disorder (NCT04336228) and as supporting physician on psychedelic studies (NCT03289949).

I collaborate with Sebastian Olbrich (University of Zurich) on EEG biomarkers, Cheng-Teng Ip (University of Macau), and Brenda Penninx and Laura Han (Amsterdam UMC), and with industry partners including AbbVie, Advanced Brain Monitoring and GLX Analytix.
